notes: Single document (UCSC TLC guide with four sample policies); both coders chose stance delegates. Matching was by source passage; B coded no passage A missed, while A split several sentences into more units. Disagreements: (1) type, the main kind, was settled by re-reading the sentence and choosing the type whose definition the sentence states (P04 vs P66/P05/P07 for the instructor-decides prompts; P19 vs P18/P22 for bans on AI producing work; P26/P24/P25 for disclosure details; P95/P99/P35/P66 for the instructor strategies); (2) actor, student vs instructor/all, resolved by taking the addressee of the sample policy text (student) for rationale and definition sentences in the samples; (3) phase and modality disagreements were mostly framing (a rationale sentence, an example citation taken as should, the guide being a recommendation so should rather than must); (4) A coded the detector evidence and caution as two units, B as one, resolved as two. A-only units kept: 13 distinct sentences or clauses; dropped 4 repeats within the same rule (A17 task list, A35 exception clause, A37 future tools, A83 second guide). Disclosure units: require changed to permit as require is reserved for required AI use. A1 phase, A82 type (P63 with fit note preserving B uncovered note) also resolved.
